name: NIIT Learning Systems Ltd
title: NIIT Learning Systems Ltd - 543952 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q1 FY27 reported growth of 25% is mostly acquisitions and a lapping RECO contract; organic constant-currency growth is 5% YoY and 2.9% QoQ, with FY27 high-single-digit guidance and margin 18-20%.

summary.headline: Q1 FY27 revenue rose 25% YoY to INR5,651 million, but organic constant-currency growth was only 5% after excluding the North American real estate contract.
summary.overview: Revenue reached INR5,651 million, up 25% YoY, helped by MST and SweetRush acquisitions; constant-currency growth was 11.4% YoY and 2.9% QoQ. Ex-acquisitions growth was 11% YoY, and organic constant-currency growth was 5% after normalising for the North American real estate (RECO) contract that ended in FY26. EBITDA was INR1,032 million (18.3% margin), up 8.5% YoY, and PAT was INR574 million, up 16.4% YoY. Management kept FY27 guidance of high single-digit revenue growth and an 18–20% EBITDA margin, and guided Q2 to 9–11% YoY growth with margins around 18%.

financial_highlights.change: +25% YoY; +11.4% YoY constant currency; +2.9% QoQ constant currency
Overall CC growth normalised for RECO: ~18%
vs INR205 million QoQ and INR181 million YoY
vs 65 days QoQ and 68 days YoY

segments.name: Industrials
segments.commentary: About 20% of revenue, grew 35% YoY, partly driven by MST joining the group.

segments.name: Technology & Telecom
segments.commentary: About 23% of revenue (largest sector), grew only 8% YoY; hit by two large clients cutting L&D budgets in the prior quarter, which have grown sequentially but not yet returned to last year's run rate.

segments.name: Management consulting & professional services
segments.commentary: About 9% of revenue, declined 16% YoY, affected by the same two client budget cuts.

segments.name: MST Group (acquired July 2025, Germany/DACH)
segments.commentary: Contributed approximately INR231 million to Q1 revenue; managed learning provider focused on automotive, industrial and energy clients.

segments.name: SweetRush (acquired January 2026, US/Costa Rica)
segments.commentary: Contributed approximately INR431 million to Q1 revenue; AI-enabled, immersive (AR/VR/XR) and strategic learning provider.

segments.name: AI-enabled services
segments.commentary: Contributed 13% of Q1 FY27 revenue; includes solutions with embedded AI and engagements where the AI studio and tools are part of delivery. AI-ready L&D Enterprise portfolio launched in June.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue growth guided at high single digits.
FY27 EBITDA margin guided at 18% to 20%, reflecting delivery discipline and phased margin build in SweetRush; management said this is unchanged from last quarter.
Q2 FY27 guidance: 9% to 11% YoY revenue growth with EBITDA margin around 18%.
Management expects QoQ growth to dampen in Q2 (European summer vacation quarter), revive in Q3, and flatten in Q4.
Management said some recent wins could accelerate growth but would talk about it only once more certain.
Long-term margin expectation of about 20% at overall level as the business scales.
capex_capacity: Capex was INR144 million in Q1 FY27.
Significant ongoing investment in AI and AI-related infrastructure build-out, cited as a major use of capital.
Management is actively evaluating acquisitions; three acquisitions completed in the past 12 months with more in the pipeline.
Investor Day planned in Mumbai, tentatively around 10 September 2026, to showcase AI-led initiatives.
demand_pricing: Three new long-term annuity contracts signed in Q1, taking the annuity client count to 113 from 95 a year earlier. New clients included a quantum computing company, a global clinical research organisation and a global hospitality company.
Expanded scope with one of the world's largest professional services firms; three renewals completed (two global pharma companies and one large US bank).
Revenue visibility USD462 million, up 19% YoY and only slightly up QoQ; management said it is net of revenue consumed and new order intake.
Top-5 client revenue share rose from 31% to 35% QoQ, attributed to a large client added in Q4.
Management cited cautious client decision-making and macro uncertainty affecting timing of new ramp-ups.
AI-enabled subscription-style revenue: a client with about 12,000 users consuming AI content, coaching and simulation services; margin profile said to be better than company average.

qa_highlights.question: When will AI-enabled learning investments meaningfully contribute to revenue, and has the FY27 EBITDA margin guidance changed?
qa_highlights.answer: AI-enabled services were 13% of Q1 FY27 revenue and are expected to grow as a share over time. FY27 EBITDA margin guidance remains 18% to 20%, unchanged from last quarter; Q1 margin was 18.3%.

qa_highlights.question: What is organic YoY growth excluding RECO, and what would QoQ organic growth look like?
qa_highlights.answer: Organic constant-currency YoY growth ex-RECO is 5%. Overall CC growth normalised for RECO is about 18%. QoQ growth of about 2.9% is overall and was not affected by RECO, since RECO was absent in both quarters; management said MST and SweetRush were in both quarters so the QoQ figure is roughly 3% on a like-for-like basis.

qa_highlights.question: Including RECO, what is organic YoY growth? Why is there no slowdown QoQ?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said RECO contributed about 6% to last year's numbers, and including it, organic YoY growth would be about negative 1.7%. Management described RECO as a contract that ended in FY26 as a result of Ontario deregulating that education, not a lost client.

qa_highlights.question: What were the margins ex-SweetRush and when will the 20% long-term margin be reached?
qa_highlights.answer: Management did not give ex-SweetRush margin. It reiterated the 18% to 20% range for FY27 and said margins should get back to close to 20% at overall level as the business scales.

qa_highlights.question: What drives high single-digit full-year growth given 3% QoQ, and is there Q2 slowdown?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said Q2 QoQ growth will dampen due to the European summer vacation quarter, revive in Q3 and flatten in Q4. Some wins could accelerate growth but management will talk about them only once more certain.

qa_highlights.question: What is the capital allocation plan given net cash and free cash flow: buybacks, acquisitions, or higher dividends?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it is actively looking at acquisitions and significant AI infrastructure investment will absorb capital. Three acquisitions were done since the capital kitty was created, more are in the pipeline, and it is keeping a consistent dividend policy; no buyback was announced.

qa_highlights.question: Why was revenue visibility up only slightly QoQ despite three annuity wins, and what drove the Top-5 client share rising from 31% to 35%?
qa_highlights.answer: Visibility is net of revenue consumed and new order intake; it grew 19% YoY to USD462 million. The three wins were average-sized, not large (large is over $5 million). The rise in Top-5 share was from a large client added in Q4.

qa_highlights.question: What is the margin profile of AI revenue and is there a subscription element?
qa_highlights.answer: AI revenue margins are better than the company average. Management described post-training coaching and simulation subscriptions lasting 6 to 12 months, similar to SaaS, with one client of about 12,000 users renewing after the first year.

qa_highlights.question: Why were MST and SweetRush prior-year numbers not shared?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said last year's numbers for the acquired entities are unaudited and were prepared under different revenue recognition models, so it would not discuss them.

risks_watch: Organic growth is only 5% CC ex-RECO and the Technology & Telecom (23% of revenue, +8% YoY) and Management consulting (9%, -16% YoY) segments remain weak; the two affected clients have not yet returned to last year's run rate.

Q2 FY27 guidance is 9% to 11% YoY growth with around 18% margin; management expects QoQ growth to dampen in the European summer quarter, so the high single-digit full-year guide relies on a Q3 revival.
Margin path: Q1 at 18.3% versus FY27 guide of 18% to 20%; SweetRush phased margin build and continued AI investment weigh on margins; ex-SweetRush margin was not disclosed.
Revenue visibility of USD462 million was only slightly up QoQ; management cited cautious client decision-making and macro uncertainty affecting timing of new ramp-ups.
Capital deployment: acquisitions and AI infrastructure are the stated uses of cash, with no buyback plan; a further acquisition could come in coming quarters.

Disclosure friction: analysts pressed on RECO adjustments and prior-year MST and SweetRush numbers, which management declined to provide; it offered a reconciliation communication later. Watch for that and the Investor Day around 10 September 2026.
key_quotes: Normalizing for that, our overall constant currency growth for Q1 FY27 came in at 18% and the organic constant currency growth is 5% year-on-year.
The year-on-year margin movement reflects the phased margin buildup of SweetRush together with the continued investment in AI as well as the sunsetting of the North American real estate contract.
We remain watchful of the macro environment and the pace of client decision-making, which can influence timing of new ramp-ups in the near term.
And that is a contract which got over, not lost, and that's a business which got over, not lost.
summary.management_tone: Management was confident on AI strategy, the annuity pipeline and the full-year guidance, but cautious on near-term demand, citing client decision-making, macro uncertainty and a seasonal Q2 dampening. It was defensive when pressed on organic growth, RECO treatment and prior-year numbers for the acquired entities, which it declined to disclose.
